title: CellVerity: verifiable per-cell fluorescence (CTCF) quantification for immunocytochemistry images
description: CellVerity (formerly ICC CTCF Ölçer) is a desktop application (macOS, Windows) that automates the ImageJ corrected total cell fluorescence (CTCF) workflow for immunocytochemistry images: CTCF = integrated density − (cell area × mean background). It reads the scale-bar calibration from cellSens images, segments cells from the FITC channel and separates touching cells using DAPI-stained nuclei, places background regions automatically (movable/manual), supports manual boundary correction (split, merge, delete, draw), batch processing of folders with FITC–DAPI pairing by image overlap, group statistics (one-way ANOVA, Kruskal–Wallis, Dunnett versus a chosen control, Tukey; statistics on cell, image or independent-experiment means) and Excel export with full provenance. Measurements are identical to ImageJ/Fiji for the same regions of interest; a built-in Fiji bridge re-measures the same ROIs with Fiji's own Analyzer and reports the differences, and manually traced Fiji ROI sets can be compared with the automatic boundaries (Bland–Altman, Dice).
notes: Developed and validated with images acquired on an Olympus BX43 fluorescence microscope, Olympus DP74 colour camera and cellSens Entry software. Example images in examples/ are licensed CC BY 4.0 (© 2021 Erdal Balcan); program code is MIT-licensed.
